title: FSA Administrator Bill Beam OR & WA Wildfires
description:
In early September 2026, Farm Service Agency (FSA) Administrator Bill Beam met with farmers and ranchers in Oregon and Washington State who have felt the impacts of devastating wildfires and drought conditions. 

In this video, he provides guidance to farmers and rancher on documenting how their operation was impacted. He encourages producers to take pictures, keep receipts, keep records of livestock losses, damaged, fences, and added feed, water and transportation costs. He also urges producers to call their local FSA office to report the losses, and that they don’t have to know FS programs. The FSA team will help walk them through any available programs that can help with recovery efforts. 

Learn more here: https://www.farmers.gov/protection-recovery/wildfire

The aerial footage in this video is of the Spokane Complex Fire in Washinton.

The ground footage of fire damage was captured in Prineville, Oregon. 

Video filmed and edited by Kirsten Strough, published on September 10, 2026.
